final: WITH g AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, n, n*1.0/(SELECT SUM(n) FROM g) AS share FROM g) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(ReportsTo AS TEXT), '') AS ReportsTo, n AS employee_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
